title: 第7章 漠尾狐第8章 火之牙
lines: 第7章漠尾狐
“你有事吗？”乔桑不得不停下来问道。
“要不是你浪费了那么多时间，我今天就不会白来这一趟。”女生埋怨道。
乔桑眉毛微皱，道：“我记得你是报到你号码的时候自己没来。”
女生来劲了，“要不是你过去的那么快，最后该办的是我，你知不知道你就坐下来两秒，我就过去了！”
乔桑有些无语。
这孩子脑子没事吧？
乔桑直接绕过她准备离开，她虽然现在是15岁，但内里却是个成年人，面前的女生穿着高中生的校服，在她眼里还是个孩子。
跟这样的熊孩子吵架吵赢有意义吗？
结果还没走两步，女生又快步走到乔桑面前拦住了她，质问道：“你走什么？”
乔桑看着她，淡淡道：“你是要打架吗？”
能动手解决的事情绝不动嘴。
跟熊孩子吵架没什么意义，但揍一顿还是有意义的。
“什么？”这回轮到女生懵了。
“打架就出去，不打架就让开。”乔桑长了双略微上挑的凤眼，平日里和和气气地只觉得好看，但她没有笑意地盯着一个人看时，还是很能唬人的。
女生怔了几秒，在乔桑穿的校服上确认了两眼，又在火牙狗跟胖家鸠身上看了一下，咬牙道：“打就打！”
两人来到杭港御兽中心后面的一处空地，这里场地说大不大说小不小，稀稀落落的人带着宠兽在这训练。
乔桑看着环境有些意外，问道：“在这里不好吧，不用去找个没人的地方吗？”
女生听完嘴角勾起几分讥笑，“怎么？你怕了？”
乔桑眉毛微挑，“我这不是怕你没面子？既然你要在这里就这里好了。”
“来吧！”女生右脚往边上一迈。
乔桑见女生摆好了阵仗，将手中的火牙狗往边上一放。
女生见状，抬起了双手，还没来得及结印，就见一条腿冲着她脸上横扫过来，她反射性地抱着头往地上一蹲。
一道风声从她头上略过。
“你做什么！”徐铃岚惊出了一身冷汗。
她起身快速地往后面退了两步，一脸惊魂未定，不敢相信眼前这个看着比她小的女生居然直接用脚踢她，而且还踢头！
这腿风，要往她头上踢她就直接脑震荡了好吧！
太凶残了！
乔桑满脸无辜，“你不是要打架吗？”
谁tm说这个打架了！
徐铃岚无语极了，她觉得她是故意的，但她没有证据。
“御兽师打架当然是用宠兽，你见过哪个御兽师直接自己动手的！”徐铃岚冲着乔桑喊道。
乔桑愣了一下，开口道：“我还不是御兽师。”
的确，她刚刚都有听到。
但这只是官方的认证，你都契约宠兽了，你说不是就不是了？
徐铃岚也不废话直接做了个印结，白色的星阵从地上蓦然亮起，一道白色的身影出现在阵中。
看着自家的宠兽，徐铃岚心里踏实起来，“我是御兽师，自然要用御兽师的方式打架，你是不是不敢用宠兽跟我打？”
对面这个凶残的女生明显是个新人御兽师，胖家鸠是中级宠兽不可能是她的，那只看着还没发育完全的火牙狗才可能是她契约的宠兽。
她的白沙狐昨天已经渡过一段进化成漠尾狐。
这家伙拿什么跟她打？

Chapter 7 Desert Tail Fox
"Are you okay?" Qiao Sang had to stop and ask.
"If you hadn't wasted so much time, my trip today wouldn't have been in vain." The girl complained.
Qiao Sang frowned slightly and said, "I remember you didn't come when I reported your number."
The girl got excited and said, "If you hadn't passed by so quickly, I would have been the one to do it in the end. Do you know that you could just sit down for two seconds and I would pass by!"
Qiao Sang was speechless.
Is this kid okay with his mind?
Qiao Sang walked around her and prepared to leave. Although she was 15 years old now, she was an adult inside. The girl in front of her was wearing a high school uniform and was still a child in her eyes.
Is there any point in winning a quarrel with such a naughty kid?
But before she even took two steps, the girl quickly walked up to Qiao Sang and stopped her, asking, "Why are you walking?"
Qiao Sang looked at her and said calmly: "Are you going to fight?"
Don't talk about things that can be solved with your hands.
There is no point in arguing with a naughty child, but there is still meaning in giving him a beating.
"What?" This time it was the girl's turn to be confused.
"If there's a fight, get out. If there's no fight, get out of the way." Qiao Sang has a pair of slightly upward-looking phoenix eyes. Normally, she only thinks they're pretty when she's kind, but when she stares at someone without a smile, she's still very capable of bluffing people.
The girl was stunned for a few seconds. She checked the school uniform worn by Qiao Sang, then looked at Huoya Dog and Fat Jiu. She gritted her teeth and said, "Just hit me!"
The two came to an open space behind the Hanggang Beast Control Center. The venue was large or small, and a few people were training with their pet animals here.
Qiao Sang looked a little surprised at the environment and asked, "Isn't it good to be here? Don't you have to find a place where no one is around?"
After hearing this, the girl's lips curled up into a sneer, "What? Are you scared?"
Qiao Sang raised his eyebrows slightly, "Aren't I afraid that you will lose face? Since you want to be here, this is the best place."
"Come on!" The girl stepped forward with her right foot.
When Qiao Sang saw that the girl had set up a formation, he put the Fire Tooth Dog in his hand to the side.
Seeing this, the girl raised her hands. Before she could form a seal, she saw a leg sweeping towards her face. She reflexively squatted down on the ground holding her head.
A sound of wind passed over her head.
"What are you doing!" Xu Linglan broke out in a cold sweat.
She stood up and took two steps back quickly, with a look of shock on her face. She couldn't believe that the girl in front of her who looked younger than her actually kicked her with her feet, and even kicked her in the head!
This leg wind, if you kick her on the head, she will get a concussion!
So cruel!
Qiao Sang looked innocent, "Don't you want to fight?"
Who said this was a fight?
Xu Linglan was speechless. She thought she did it on purpose, but she had no evidence.
"Of course a beast master fights with his pet beast. Have you ever seen any beast master do it himself?" Xu Linglan shouted at Qiao Sang.
Qiao Sang was stunned for a moment and said, "I'm not a beast master yet."
Xu Linglan: "..."
Indeed, she just heard it.
But this is just an official certification. You have already contracted a pet beast. If you say it’s not the case, then it’s not?
Xu Linglan made a seal without any nonsense. The white star array suddenly lit up from the ground, and a white figure appeared in the array.
Looking at her pet beast, Xu Linglan felt at ease, "I am a beast master, so naturally I have to fight in the manner of a beast master. Don't you dare to fight me with your pet beast?"
The ferocious girl across from him was obviously a new beast master. The fat pigeon was an intermediate pet beast and could not be hers. The Fire Tooth Dog, which looked not yet fully developed, could be her contracted pet beast.
Her white sand fox had gone through a period of evolution into a desert-tailed fox yesterday.
What is this guy using to fight her?
